correctness.rationale: The irredundant facet normals are u_i=e_i, v_i=-e_i-e_(i+1), w=-sum e_i. At vertex p_S (independent, |S|=k), active u-rays for i not in S and 2k active edge v-rays, plus w iff k=m. The n rays {u_i:i not in S} ∪ {v_s:s in S} are unimodular (triangular minor ±1), so Cl(local) is free of rank k+1_(k=m). The integral character h=(-1 outside S,2 on S) pairs -1 with active u,v, and pairs 1-m with w at k=m, hence K=(m-2)[D_odd] primitive and zero when k<m. For face F_0, the m+1 maximal independent sets avoiding 0 have successive indicator differences e_(2r+1)-e_(2r+2), yielding a unimodular m-simplex and Z_0≅P^m linearly. Its generic normal cone has rays u0, the m alternate v-rays and w=sum(v)-u0, giving free local Cl rank one and K coefficient m-2, non-Q-Cartier. Miyazaki Thm 3.4 supplies known non-Gorenstein support; the generic non-Q-Cartier loci force equality. Face monomial ideals yield scheme-theoretic pair intersection corresponding to F_i∩F_j, a simplex with q or m-q+1 retained vertices. Independently enumerated all 29 independent sets of C7 and face intersections counts [1,3,2,2,3,1], agreeing with formulas. Source finite verification read, not used as proof in unbounded m.

value.rationale: Refines the singular-locus picture from a union of abstract orbit closures to explicit projective geometry, pairwise intersection incidence and local canonical-class obstructions. These local invariants measure precisely why the components fail Q-Gorenstein and can be used in toric birational/singularity calculations; it is a motivated natural complete classification, not an arbitrary fixed small cycle table.

final_claim: For the complex normal projective toric variety of the chordless odd C_(2m+1) stable-set polytope (m>=3), the non-Q-Gorenstein and non-Gorenstein loci both equal the union of n face-orbit closures Z_i, each a linearly embedded P^m of codimension m+1. Generic local class group is Z with K=(m-2) primitive. Fixed-point local class groups have rank k+1_(k=m) at independent sets of size k, and the intersections Z_i∩Z_(i+δ) are exact linear projective spaces of dimensions q-1 (δ=2q-1) and m-q (δ=2q).
limitations: m>=3 odd chordless cycles only; n5 has m-2=0 and is excluded; projective stable-set toric normal model, not arbitrary graph or all orbit local rings.
